lowest_examples.response_excerpt: We need to run like this: ./x86.py -p loop.s -t 1 -i 100 -R dx -c Here is how it’s executed. It simply subtracts 1 from %dx register, then tests it’s value, as long as it’s not >= 0, it halts.
%dx will be 0 before the run, and -1 during the run.
